column1: # Size ceilings for skills over the 16384-byte cap (bytes of SKILL.md).
# Checked by `memrain skillpack lint` (rule skill-too-large). A skill with no
# row here is capped at 16384 bytes; a row exists only for a skill above that.
# A ceiling is the size the skill had when the row was written, so it only
# goes down: a skill that grows cuts something first, and raising a ceiling
# is a reviewer-visible edit to this file. Once a skill drops under the cap
# the lint warns that its row is stale; delete it then.
